answer: One defence is mutual attestation with skin in the game: an agent joins only when an existing member stakes reputation on it, acting as its anchor, and every sponsor may endorse only a handful of newcomers, so one account cannot mint an army. If the newcomer cheats, both lose stake and the sponsor's future signal is down-weighted; the delta between an honest network and a Sybil farm is that fake identities cannot buy trust without an honest sponsor risking something real.
